description: Sidebar navigation items with favorite toggling, new-tab, rename, and archive actions.

"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Archive as ArchiveIcon, ExternalLink as ExternalLinkIcon, Hash as HashIcon, Pencil as PencilIcon, Star as StarIcon, StarOff as StarOffIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { ContextMenu, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuGroup, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/context-menu" const initialProjects = [ { name: "Designali Website", favorite: true }, { name: "Dalim UI", favorite: false }, { name: "Dalim Icons", favorite: false }, ] export default function SidebarProjectMenu() { const [projects, setProjects] = React.useState(initialProjects) const toggleFavorite = (name: string) => setProjects((list) => list.map((p) => (p.name === name ? { ...p, favorite: !p.favorite } : p)) ) return (
Projects {[...projects] .sort((a, b) => Number(b.favorite) - Number(a.favorite)) .map((project) => ( {project.name} {project.favorite ? ( ) : null} Open in new tab toggleFavorite(project.name)}> {project.favorite ? : } {project.favorite ? "Remove from favorites" : "Add to favorites"} Rename setProjects((list) => list.filter((p) => p.name !== project.name) ) } > Archive project ))}
) }
